'Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind' — Cyril marks the threefold-anthropology (heart + soul + mind = kardia + psychē + dianoia) as the totality-of-personhood under the great-commandment. The agapēseis (you-shall-love) is imperative-future; love is commanded BECAUSE it is freely-willed. The Deut 6:5 Shema is fulfilled-in-Christ (the Lord-thy-God whom Israel loves IS the incarnate Word standing before them). Tewahedo catechetical-introduction (the Säwasǝw-of-Catechumens) cites Mt 22:37-40 + Deut 6:4-5 + Lev 19:18 as the entire-Torah summary.

Athanasius of Alexandria Orationes contra Arianos II.13 (c. 350 AD)

'He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?' — Athanasius marks David en Pneumati kalei auton kyrion (David in-the-Spirit calls him Lord) as the SCRIPTURE-PNEUMATIC-INSPIRATION + DAVIDIC-SON-IS-DAVIDIC-LORD double-anchor. The Spirit-of-prophecy gave David the Ps 110:1-vision of his-Son-as-his-Lord — the Davidic-Son's-pre-Davidic-divinity. Christ's own argument in Mt 22:41-46 is Athanasius's exegetical-paradigm for reading the Old Testament: every OT-pre-Christian text was-spoken-in-the-Spirit and pointed-Christologically toward the Word's incarnation.
